goal: A free (local, no paid cloud) 3D model of the reference robot with its native PBR texture, as close to the reference as possible: white armor plates, dark joints, small red accents, a clean face, separate limbs and hands. Target: review pass with score 9 or more. The paid baselines Meshy retexture and Tripo P2 scored 8/10.

model.help: Image-to-3D model. pixal3d (TRELLIS.2 fine-tune, sharper projection of the image) or trellis2 (Microsoft base model).

image.help: Input image. robot_ref: the original reference (front, full body). id_front: a Krea-2 identity front view of the same robot, cleaner light.

seed.help: Random seed for structure, shape and texture sampling.

shape_cfg.help: Guidance of the detailed shape stage. Lower: smoother, fewer artifacts (3.5 gave the cleanest pelvis before). Higher: follows the image harder.

structure_cfg.help: Guidance of the coarse structure (overall silhouette, limbs separated or fused).

tex_cfg.help: Guidance of the texture stage. 1 is the default; higher can sharpen colors but may add noise.

moves: Gray or untextured result, or a blocky placeholder: try another seed; if it repeats, switch model.
Fused or blobby limbs, hands merged with the body: raise structure_cfg a little or try another seed.
Lumpy surface, extra bulges (pelvis, belly): lower shape_cfg toward 3.0-3.5.
Smeared or wrong face, colors drift from the reference: try image id_front, or tex_cfg 1.5-2.
A good result: keep its levers and try 1-2 nearby seeds to see if it holds, then compare models.

steps.label: Review: model and texture
criteria: The model and texture belong to the same robot as the reference: white armor plates, dark joints, small red accents.
Clean, readable face and head; no seams, smears or blurred patches.
Separated, well-formed limbs and hands that would rig and deform well.
